# Data Dictionary — Synthetic Property Valuation

**Source System:** Valuation / Collateral Management System  
**File:** Generated by `01_source_data/load_scripts/04_generate_property_valuation.py`  
**Delimiter:** Comma (`,`)  
**Header Row:** Yes  
**Encoding:** UTF-8  
**Grain:** One row per property (one property per loan in this demo)

## Overview

The property valuation file represents the bank's internal Collateral Management
System — the authoritative record for the security property held against each
mortgage. It includes both the original valuation at origination and the most
recently refreshed automated valuation model (AVM) estimate.

This file is particularly interesting for the mapping demo because its column
naming convention is deliberately different from the Freddie Mac origination file
(which also contains some property attributes) — creating a realistic scenario
where the agent must recognise that `PROP_CURRENT_VAL_AMT` and `CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT`
refer to the same concept as the domain model's `current_market_value`.

## Columns

| Column Name | Type | Nullable | Description |
|-------------|------|----------|-------------|
| PROPERTY_ID | VARCHAR(20) | N | Bank-assigned unique property identifier. Format: PROP-XXXXXXXX. Primary key. |
| LOAN_SEQUENCE_NUMBER | CHAR(12) | N | Foreign key linking to Freddie Mac origination file. |
| CUSTOMER_ID | VARCHAR(20) | N | Foreign key linking to Borrower Profile file. |
| STREET_NUMBER | VARCHAR(10) | N | Property street number. |
| STREET_NAME | VARCHAR(80) | N | Property street name (excluding type). |
| STREET_TYPE | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Street type abbreviation. St, Rd, Ave, Blvd, Dr, Ct, Pl, etc. |
| UNIT_NUMBER | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Unit or apartment number. Null for standalone properties. |
| SUBURB | VARCHAR(60) | N | Suburb or town name. |
| STATE | CHAR(3) | N | Australian state abbreviation. |
| POSTCODE | CHAR(4) | N | Australian 4-digit postcode. |
| PROPERTY_TYPE_CODE | CHAR(2) | N | Property type. SF=Single Family House, TH=Townhouse, AP=Apartment/Unit, RU=Rural, VA=Vacant Land. |
| PROPERTY_TYPE_DESC | VARCHAR(40) | N | Full description of PROPERTY_TYPE_CODE. |
| LAND_AREA_SQM | DECIMAL(10,2) | Y | Total land area in square metres. Null for strata/apartment titles. |
| FLOOR_AREA_SQM | DECIMAL(10,2) | Y | Internal floor area in square metres. |
| BEDROOMS | INTEGER | Y | Number of bedrooms. |
| BATHROOMS | DECIMAL(3,1) | Y | Number of bathrooms (0.5 = toilet only). |
| CAR_SPACES | INTEGER | Y | Number of covered/garage car spaces. |
| YEAR_BUILT | INTEGER | Y | Year of construction. Null if unknown. |
| ZONING_CODE | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Local government zoning classification (e.g. R1, R2, E1, B1). |
| COUNCIL_AREA | VARCHAR(60) | Y | Local government area name. |
| TITLE_REFERENCE | VARCHAR(40) | Y | Land title reference number. |
| LOT_NUMBER | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Lot number on deposited plan. |
| PLAN_NUMBER | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Deposited plan or strata plan number. |
| STRATA_FLAG | CHAR(1) | N | Y=Strata/community title, N=Torrens/freehold title. |
| HERITAGE_LISTED | CHAR(1) | N | Y=Heritage listed, N=Not listed. |
| ORIG_VALUATION_DATE | DATE | N | Date of the formal valuation at origination. |
| ORIG_VALUATION_AMOUNT | DECIMAL(15,2) | N | Formal valuation amount at origination in AUD. |
| ORIG_VALUATION_METHOD | VARCHAR(20) | N | Valuation method at origination. Full, Kerbside, Desktop, AVM. |
| ORIG_VALUER_NAME | VARCHAR(80) | Y | Name of the valuation firm that conducted the origination valuation. |
| CURRENT_VALUATION_DATE | DATE | Y | Date of most recent AVM refresh. |
| CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT | DECIMAL(15,2) | Y | Most recent AVM or formal valuation amount in AUD. |
| CURRENT_VALUATION_METHOD | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Method used for current valuation. Typically AVM for refreshes. |
| ESTIMATED_LVR | DECIMAL(6,3) | Y | Current estimated LVR based on CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT and current UPB. |
| FLOOD_RISK_ZONE | VARCHAR(10) | Y | Flood risk classification. Low, Medium, High, Overland Flow. Null if not assessed. |
| FIRE_RISK_ZONE | VARCHAR(10) | Y | Bushfire risk classification. Low, Medium, High, Extreme. Null if not in risk area. |
| ENVIRONMENTAL_CONSTRAINT | CHAR(1) | N | Y=Environmental constraint or covenant applies, N=None known. |
| PROPERTY_STATUS | VARCHAR(20) | N | Current status of the property in the collateral system. Active, Released, Substituted, Sold. |
| RECORD_CREATED_DATE | DATE | N | Date the collateral record was created. |
| RECORD_LAST_UPDATED | DATE | N | Date the collateral record was most recently updated. |

## Key Business Rules

- One property per loan in this demo; in production a property can secure multiple loans
- `ESTIMATED_LVR` is a derived field — it is calculated from `CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT` and the current UPB from the servicing system
- `ORIG_VALUATION_AMOUNT` should be consistent with `ORIG_UPB / ORIG_LTV * 100` from the Freddie Mac origination file (within rounding)
- `FLOOD_RISK_ZONE` and `FIRE_RISK_ZONE` are critical for risk-weighted asset calculation under APRA requirements
- Properties in `PROPERTY_STATUS = 'Released'` indicate the mortgage has been discharged

## Domain Model Target Entities

| Source Column(s) | Target Entity | Notes |
|-----------------|---------------|-------|
| PROPERTY_ID | Property | Primary key |
| STREET_NUMBER..POSTCODE | PropertyAddress | Physical address |
| PROPERTY_TYPE_CODE, LAND_AREA_SQM..YEAR_BUILT | PropertyCharacteristics | Physical attributes |
| ORIG_VALUATION_DATE, ORIG_VALUATION_AMOUNT | PropertyValuation | Point-in-time valuation event |
| CURRENT_VALUATION_DATE, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT | PropertyValuation | Latest valuation |
| FLOOD_RISK_ZONE, FIRE_RISK_ZONE, ENVIRONMENTAL_CONSTRAINT | PropertyRisk | Risk attributes |
| TITLE_REFERENCE, LOT_NUMBER, PLAN_NUMBER | PropertyTitle | Legal title details |
